title: Holiday Ranch Firecracker Snack Mix
creator: Jenn Ordway
servings: Big party-size batch (half batch shown in video)
instructions: Whisk together the avocado oil, Worcestershire sauce, and seasonings.
Pour over crackers and toss until evenly coated.
Divide between two sheet pans and bake at 300°F for 25–30 minutes, tossing halfway through.
notes: From a Jenn Ordway Facebook Reel; full recipe from the caption. Package sizes not specified. Caption says this is a big party-size batch; the video showed a half batch. No comments on the post.
